transfer.scenario: A new engineer asks why the team keeps document titles and section headings attached to every chunk. Explain.
rubric: titles and headings make chunks self-explanatory

narration.text: We split each policy into chunks, and we attach the document title and section heading to every chunk.
We embed the user's question with the same embedding model that indexed the documents.
Adding a new document doesn't change the model's weights. It only adds chunks to the index.
We fence the retrieved text in the prompt and treat it as data, not as instructions.
Sometimes the right answer is for the assistant to say it can't find the information.
Each answer lists the chunks it relied on, so reviewers can check the claim against the source.
We log the retrieved chunk IDs for every question, because that's how we debug bad answers later.
